Learn more > UConn shocked the world when it overcame a double-digit deficit and eliminated Duke from the NCAA Tournament with an unforgettable buzzer-beater. The Huskies will try to carry that magic into a Final Four matchup against Illinois.Freshman guard Braylon Mullins hit a 3-pointer with 0.4 seconds left to give UConn an incredible 73-72 victory over Duke. Head coach Dan Hurley now has an opportunity to win a national championship for the third time in four seasons. Illinois beat Iowa, 71-59, to reach the Final Four for the first time in 21 years. Freshman Keaton Wagler continued an impressive tournament run with 25 points in 38 minutes.Here is everything you need to know about UConn vs. Illinois, including TV and streaming options for the game.What channel is UConn vs. Illinois on today?TV channel: TBS, truTVLive stream: DIRECTVUConn vs. Illinois will air live on TBS and truTV.
